selection_reason: Previously used alignment-review planes; no matching results used to select slices
specimen_scope: Two additional slices of the SAME BigBrain specimen, not new subjects
experiment: Frozen MIND-style descriptors + source top-3 + one-to-one relational similarity consensus

mind_config.name: mind2d_context_v1
mind_config.presmoothing: sigma=max(0.7, radius/20*0.7), truncate=4; full support required
mind_config.normalization: exp(-SSD/mean cardinal SSD), divide channel max, flatten and L2
mind_config.similarity: max cosine: source angle 0, all target angles and all 3x3 radius pairs
mind_config.caveat: 2D MIND-style adaptation; not original dense 3D MIND or MIND-SSC; scores not probabilities

relational_config.hypotheses: Exhaustive two-proposal similarity fits; distinct source and target
relational_config.assignment: Maximum cardinality one-to-one among residual<6 proposals, then minimum squared residual
relational_config.selection: Most final assigned pairs, then smallest squared residual, then largest cosine sum
relational_config.refinement: At most three assignment/refit iterations; residual<6; noncollinear on both sides
relational_config.pruning: Rank initial support upper bounds; skip hypotheses below best final count; heuristic after refits, not global optimality guarantee
relational_config.reference_access: None during proposal selection, hypothesis ranking or fit
relational_config.caveat: New deterministic geometry solver; mutual proposals also run through it as a solver control

visual_review_gate: New prepared images must be reviewed by user before matching
